briefing: Elite: Moon-Stone Restoration: War Memory. Tuatha advances through moon-stone ring where living terrain changes after every objective while the Gate tests whether the living world adapts and endures.

missionIntro.speaker: Tuatha Titan Voice
missionIntro.text: The field asks for proof. One active Titan enter, and The Thorn-Memory Gate will remember how we answer.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Lore Director
enemyIntroduction.text: Threats emerge to test Roots Below the Gate: pressure first, revelation only when the field is held.

midBattle.speaker: Gameplay Director
midBattle.text: Hold the lane, read the hazard, and spend movement as if it were blood.

victory.speaker: Tuatha Titan Voice
victory.text: The Gate has not yielded. It has recorded that we did not break.

defeat.speaker: Tuatha Titan Voice
defeat.text: Fall back before the wound learns our full shape.

codex.speaker: Lore Director
codex.text: This mission keeps Tuatha doctrine intact: Their memory is power, but it can become vengeance when old wounds refuse to compost.
